name: yahoo-search-cpi
note: Hand-made, not recorded (Yahoo answers only yahoo-finance2's own User-Agent, and none was recorded here): Yahoo's v1 search answer in the shape yahoo-finance2 4.0.6's search schema validates (SearchResult with SearchQuoteYahoo rows: symbol, exchange, exchDisp, shortname, longname, quoteType, typeDisp, index, score, isYahooFinance), asked as the instrument search asks (quotesCount 100, newsCount 0), for "CPI": a company whose name starts with the letters (CPI Card Group, PMTS). The rows carry Yahoo's symbols, exchange codes and quote types for these instruments; the names follow Yahoo's, the scores are invented.
